description: One set of divisors that sums to half the divisor-sum, comma-separated, taking the earliest divisors. 6 gives "1,2,3" and 20 gives "2,4,5,10". An odd sum is rejected, and a missing split is rejected. n runs from 1 to 2000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/zumkeller-subset
